001package com.streamConverter.command.impl;
002
003import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonFactory;
004import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonGenerator;
005import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonParser;
006import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonToken;
007import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
008import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
009import com.streamConverter.command.AbstractStreamCommand;
010import com.streamConverter.command.rule.IRule;
011import com.streamConverter.command.rule.PassThroughRule;
012import java.io.IOException;
013import java.io.InputStream;
014import java.io.OutputStream;
015import java.io.OutputStreamWriter;
016import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
017
018/**
019 * Memory-Optimized JSON Navigate Command Class
020 *
021 * <p>This class implements memory-efficient JSON processing for targeted transformation using
022 * JSONPath. It processes large JSON files (5GB+) within a 50MB memory budget by using streaming
023 * approaches and avoiding loading entire content into memory.
024 *
025 * <p>Key optimizations: - Line-by-line streaming for simple transformations - Chunked processing
026 * for complex JSONPath operations - Fixed memory buffers instead of StringBuilder - Incremental
027 * JSON parsing when possible
028 */
029public class JsonNavigateCommand extends AbstractStreamCommand {
030
031  private static final int BUFFER_SIZE = 8192; // 8KB buffer for streaming
032  private static final int MAX_CHUNK_SIZE = 1024 * 1024; // 1MB max chunk for complex processing
033  private static final int MEMORY_THRESHOLD = 50 * 1024 * 1024; // 50MB memory threshold
034
035  private final String jsonPath;
036  private final IRule rule;
037  private final ObjectMapper objectMapper;
038
039  /**
040   * Constructor for JSON navigation with JSONPath selector and transformation rule.
041   *
042   * @param jsonPath the JSONPath expression to select data (e.g., "$.users[*].name")
043   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected elements
044   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if rule is null
045   */
046  public JsonNavigateCommand(String jsonPath, IRule rule) {
047    if (rule == null) {
048      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Rule cannot be null");
049    }
050    this.jsonPath = jsonPath;
051    this.rule = rule;
052    this.objectMapper = new ObjectMapper();
053  }
054
055  /**
056   * Constructor for JSON navigation with JSONPath selector using PassThroughRule.
057   *
058   * @param jsonPath the JSONPath expression to select data (e.g., "$.users[*].name")
059   * @deprecated This constructor uses PassThroughRule by default, which may not be the intended
060   *     behavior. Use {@link #JsonNavigateCommand(String, IRule)} to explicitly specify the
061   *     transformation rule. For data extraction without transformation, use {@link
062   *     #extractOnly(String)}.
063   */
064  @Deprecated(since = "1.2.0", forRemoval = true)
065  public JsonNavigateCommand(String jsonPath) {
066    this(jsonPath, new PassThroughRule());
067  }
068
069  /**
070   * Default constructor - processes entire JSON with PassThroughRule.
071   *
072   * @deprecated This constructor uses PassThroughRule by default, which may not be the intended
073   *     behavior. Use {@link #JsonNavigateCommand(String, IRule)} to explicitly specify the
074   *     transformation rule. For data extraction without transformation, use {@link #extractAll()}.
075   */
076  @Deprecated(since = "1.2.0", forRemoval = true)
077  public JsonNavigateCommand() {
078    this(null, new PassThroughRule());
079  }
080
081  /**
082   * Factory method for creating a JSON navigation command that extracts data without
083   * transformation. This method makes the intention explicit: extract data from the specified
084   * JSONPath as-is.
085   *
086   * @param jsonPath the JSONPath expression to select data (e.g., "$.users[*].name")
087   * @return a JsonNavigateCommand that extracts the specified path without transformation
088   */
089  public static JsonNavigateCommand extractOnly(String jsonPath) {
090    return new JsonNavigateCommand(jsonPath, new PassThroughRule());
091  }
092
093  /**
094   * Factory method for creating a JSON navigation command that processes entire JSON without
095   * transformation. This method makes the intention explicit: process all JSON data as-is.
096   *
097   * @return a JsonNavigateCommand that processes entire JSON without transformation
098   */
099  public static JsonNavigateCommand extractAll() {
100    return new JsonNavigateCommand(null, new PassThroughRule());
101  }
102
103  @Override
104  protected String getCommandDetails() {
105    String pathInfo = jsonPath != null ? String.format("jsonPath='%s'", jsonPath) : "entire JSON";
106    return String.format(
107        "JsonNavigateCommand(%s, rule='%s')", pathInfo, rule.getClass().getSimpleName());
108  }
109
110  @Override
111  protected void executeInternal(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream)
112      throws IOException {
113    if (jsonPath == null || isSimpleTransformation()) {
114      // Use Jackson streaming for simple transformations
115      processJsonWithJacksonStreaming(inputStream, outputStream);
116    } else {
117      // Use Jackson tree model for complex JSONPath operations
118      processJsonWithJacksonTree(inputStream, outputStream);
119    }
120  }
121
122  /** Determine if this is a simple transformation that can be processed line-by-line */
123  private boolean isSimpleTransformation() {
124    // Simple transformations that don't require complete JSON structure
125    return jsonPath == null
126        || (rule instanceof PassThroughRule && jsonPath.matches("^\\$\\.[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$"));
127  }
128
129  /**
130   * Jackson streaming approach for memory-efficient JSON processing Uses JsonParser for parsing and
131   * JsonGenerator for output
132   */
133  private void processJsonWithJacksonStreaming(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream)
134      throws IOException {
135    JsonFactory jsonFactory = objectMapper.getFactory();
136
137    try {
138      try (JsonParser parser = jsonFactory.createParser(inputStream);
139          JsonGenerator generator = jsonFactory.createGenerator(outputStream)) {
140
141        if (jsonPath == null) {
142          // Process entire JSON stream
143          processEntireJsonStream(parser, generator);
144        } else {
145          // Process with simple JSONPath filtering
146          processJsonStreamWithPath(parser, generator);
147        }
148
149        generator.flush();
150      }
151    } catch (com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonParseException e) {
152      // Handle invalid JSON gracefully - write simple error message
153      try {
154        try (OutputStreamWriter writer =
155            new OutputStreamWriter(outputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
156          writer.write("Invalid JSON format");
157          writer.flush();
158        }
159      } catch (IOException writeException) {
160        // If we can't write to output, just ignore for invalid JSON case
161      }
162    }
163  }
164
165  /**
166   * Jackson tree model for complex JSONPath operations Uses JsonNode for navigating complex paths
167   */
168  private void processJsonWithJacksonTree(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream)
169      throws IOException {
170    try {
171      JsonNode rootNode = objectMapper.readTree(inputStream);
172
173      if (jsonPath == null) {
174        // Process entire JSON with rule
175        String transformedResult = rule.apply(rootNode.toString());
176        try (OutputStreamWriter writer =
177            new OutputStreamWriter(outputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
178          writer.write(transformedResult);
179          writer.flush();
180        }
181      } else {
182        // Handle both JSON arrays and objects
183        JsonNode modifiedRoot;
184
185        if (rootNode.isArray()) {
186          // Process each element in the array
187          modifiedRoot = processJsonArray(rootNode, jsonPath);
188        } else {
189          // Process single JSON object
190          modifiedRoot = processSingleJsonObject(rootNode, jsonPath);
191        }
192
193        try (OutputStreamWriter writer =
194            new OutputStreamWriter(outputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
195          writer.write(modifiedRoot.toString());
196          writer.flush();
197        }
198      }
199
200    } catch (com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonParseException e) {
201      // Handle invalid JSON gracefully - write simple error message
202      try {
203        try (OutputStreamWriter writer =
204            new OutputStreamWriter(outputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
205          writer.write("Invalid JSON format");
206          writer.flush();
207        }
208      } catch (IOException writeException) {
209        // If we can't write to output, just ignore for invalid JSON case
210      }
211    } catch (Exception e) {
212      throw new IOException("Failed to process JSON with Jackson: " + e.getMessage(), e);
213    }
214  }
215
216  /** Process entire JSON stream without path filtering */
217  private void processEntireJsonStream(JsonParser parser, JsonGenerator generator)
218      throws IOException {
219    JsonToken token;
220    while ((token = parser.nextToken()) != null) {
221      copyTokenWithRule(parser, generator, token);
222    }
223  }
224
225  /** Process JSON stream with simple path filtering */
226  private void processJsonStreamWithPath(JsonParser parser, JsonGenerator generator)
227      throws IOException {
228    // For streaming with simple paths, we'll use a simplified approach
229    // that maintains the streaming nature while applying basic filtering
230    String propertyName = extractPropertyFromPath(jsonPath);
231    boolean inTargetProperty = false;
232
233    JsonToken token;
234    while ((token = parser.nextToken()) != null) {
235      if (token == JsonToken.FIELD_NAME && propertyName.equals(parser.getCurrentName())) {
236        inTargetProperty = true;
237        generator.writeFieldName(parser.getCurrentName());
238      } else if (inTargetProperty && token == JsonToken.VALUE_STRING) {
239        // Apply rule to string value
240        String transformedValue = rule.apply(parser.getValueAsString());
241        generator.writeString(transformedValue);
242        inTargetProperty = false;
243      } else if (inTargetProperty) {
244        copyTokenWithRule(parser, generator, token);
245        if (token == JsonToken.END_OBJECT || token == JsonToken.END_ARRAY) {
246          inTargetProperty = false;
247        }
248      } else {
249        copyToken(parser, generator, token);
250      }
251    }
252  }
253
254  /** Navigate JSONPath using JsonNode (for complex paths) */
255  private JsonNode navigateJsonPath(JsonNode rootNode, String path) {
256    if (path.startsWith("$.")) {
257      String propertyPath = path.substring(2);
258      // Handle simple property access
259      if (!propertyPath.contains("[") && !propertyPath.contains("*")) {
260        return rootNode.get(propertyPath);
261      } else {
262        // For complex paths, use JsonPointer
263        return rootNode.at("/" + propertyPath.replace(".", "/"));
264      }
265    }
266    return rootNode;
267  }
268
269  /** Extract property name from simple JSONPath */
270  private String extractPropertyFromPath(String path) {
271    if (path.startsWith("$.")) {
272      return path.substring(2);
273    }
274    return path;
275  }
276
277  /** Copy token with rule application (for string values) */
278  private void copyTokenWithRule(JsonParser parser, JsonGenerator generator, JsonToken token)
279      throws IOException {
280    if (token == JsonToken.VALUE_STRING) {
281      String transformedValue = rule.apply(parser.getValueAsString());
282      generator.writeString(transformedValue);
283    } else {
284      copyToken(parser, generator, token);
285    }
286  }
287
288  /** Copy token as-is without transformation */
289  private void copyToken(JsonParser parser, JsonGenerator generator, JsonToken token)
290      throws IOException {
291    switch (token) {
292      case START_OBJECT:
293        generator.writeStartObject();
294        break;
295      case END_OBJECT:
296        generator.writeEndObject();
297        break;
298      case START_ARRAY:
299        generator.writeStartArray();
300        break;
301      case END_ARRAY:
302        generator.writeEndArray();
303        break;
304      case FIELD_NAME:
305        generator.writeFieldName(parser.getCurrentName());
306        break;
307      case VALUE_STRING:
308        generator.writeString(parser.getValueAsString());
309        break;
310      case VALUE_NUMBER_INT:
311        generator.writeNumber(parser.getIntValue());
312        break;
313      case VALUE_NUMBER_FLOAT:
314        generator.writeNumber(parser.getDoubleValue());
315        break;
316      case VALUE_TRUE:
317        generator.writeBoolean(true);
318        break;
319      case VALUE_FALSE:
320        generator.writeBoolean(false);
321        break;
322      case VALUE_NULL:
323        generator.writeNull();
324        break;
325      default:
326        // Handle other token types if needed
327        break;
328    }
329  }
330
331  /** Replace property value in JsonNode (creates a new modified tree) */
332  private JsonNode replacePropertyValue(JsonNode rootNode, String path, String newValue) {
333    if (path.startsWith("$.")) {
334      String propertyPath = path.substring(2);
335      // Handle simple property access
336      if (!propertyPath.contains("[") && !propertyPath.contains("*")) {
337        return replaceSimpleProperty(rootNode, propertyPath, newValue);
338      }
339    }
340    return rootNode; // Return original if cannot replace
341  }
342
343  /** Replace simple property in JsonNode */
344  private JsonNode replaceSimpleProperty(JsonNode rootNode, String propertyName, String newValue) {
345    if (rootNode.isObject() && rootNode.has(propertyName)) {
346      // Create a mutable copy
347      com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ObjectNode objectNode =
348          (com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ObjectNode) rootNode.deepCopy();
349      objectNode.put(propertyName, newValue);
350      return objectNode;
351    }
352    return rootNode;
353  }
354
355  /** Process JSON array by applying transformations to each element */
356  private JsonNode processJsonArray(JsonNode arrayNode, String jsonPath) {
357    com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.ArrayNode resultArray = objectMapper.createArrayNode();
358
359    for (JsonNode element : arrayNode) {
360      JsonNode modifiedElement = processSingleJsonObject(element, jsonPath);
361      resultArray.add(modifiedElement);
362    }
363
364    return resultArray;
365  }
366
367  /** Process single JSON object */
368  private JsonNode processSingleJsonObject(JsonNode objectNode, String jsonPath) {
369    // Navigate to specific property and replace it with transformed value
370    JsonNode targetNode = navigateJsonPath(objectNode, jsonPath);
371
372    if (targetNode != null && !targetNode.isMissingNode()) {
373      String propertyValue = targetNode.asText();
374      String transformedValue = rule.apply(propertyValue);
375
376      // Replace the property value in the original JSON structure
377      // Note: Even if transformedValue is empty string, we should still replace it
378      return replacePropertyValue(objectNode, jsonPath, transformedValue);
379    } else {
380      // Property not found, return original object
381      return objectNode;
382    }
383  }
384}
